test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an INCORRECTLY spelt word.

Since the health hazards have reduced, / the ministry has relaxed the earlier regulations / and has suggested only a short period / of quarrantine for the affected people.

options.text: of quarrantine for the affected people
the ministry has relaxed the earlier regulations
Since the health hazards have reduced
and has suggested only a short period

solution:
The correct answer is '**of quarrantine for the affected people**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Option 1**, "**quarrantine**" is misspelled. The correct spelling is "**quarantine**".
 
• **Option 2**, **Option 3**, and **Option 4** all have **correctly spelled words** and do not contain any spelling errors.
 
• Recognizing the correct spelling of "**quarantine**" is crucial for accurate communication, particularly in contexts relating to health and safety.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is of quarrantine for the affected people.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: No spelling errors detected; this segment is correctly written.
 
• **Option 3**: This segment also does not contain any spelling mistakes.
 
• **Option 4**: Similarly, this part of the sentence is free from spelling errors.
